Name: (CP) Girls Into Boys - Male Abigail (Abaddon)
Author: atoms2ashes
Description:
Changes Abigail's portrait, sprite, and dialogue gender to male. Also changes name to Abaddon.
Abaddon is so goth he even changed his name to fit his whole look. His parents still call him Abe.

[b]Changes in Version 1.2.0 (July 16, 2020)
[/b]- Quest, Mail, Egg Festival, and Secret Diary dialogue now changed to use new name and male pronouns.
- Portraits now updated (old file still available in the assets folder in case you prefer the old look)

Installation:
1. Install Content Patcher
2. Unzip file in your Mods folder
